== Summary ==
Identified: [[Kevin Jaap]] (grey striped hoodie, bald, glasses, and a beard; same face as [[:File:2025 European Championship team event 5.jpg]]) and [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (2025 Ithor Regionals tee and cargo shorts; same face as [[:File:Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]] and the second player from the left in [[:File:2025 Ithor Regionals players.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled, including the player in an orange tee, the player in a "THE LEGEND" tee, the player in a brown "MAN the GUNS!" tee (same person as [[:File:2025 European Championship 23.jpg]]), and the seated player in a cap and patterned shorts.


Players gathered around a table in the hall at the [[2025 European Championship]] at Zu den Vier Winden in Bochum (19–21 September 2025).

* '''Event:''' [[2025 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2025-09-26
* '''Identification:''' [[Kevin Jaap]] (grey striped hoodie, bald, glasses, and a beard; same face as [[:File:2025 European Championship team event 5.jpg]]) and [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (2025 Ithor Regionals tee and cargo shorts; same face as [[:File:Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]] and the second player from the left in [[:File:2025 Ithor Regionals players.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled, including the player in an orange tee, the player in a "THE LEGEND" tee, the player in a brown "MAN the GUNS!" tee (same person as [[:File:2025 European Championship 23.jpg]]), and the seated player in a cap and patterned shorts.
